$Comment: Ice King in phase 3 (Fridjitzu): AT_Ice_King with the beard wrapped over his mouth (Beard_Wrapped attachment, custom model). Everything else comes from the Parent: model, texture, animations. DefaultAttachments is the whole list again because a child replaces it. AnimationSets: only the sets that differ in phase 3 (the rest come from AT_Ice_King): Animations/Fridjitzu/*_Fridjitzu copies (angry brows; animated by hand: Idle_Fridjitzu, scripts/copy-pose.py copies its brow keys to the others). Frost_Beam attachment (2026-10-21): the ultimate's giant ray, a fullbright translucent box (Frost_Beam + Frost_Beam_Core) on the Head bone, so it points where his head looks like the Stab hit box (HeadRotation), and the charge orb (Frost_Orb, its own attachment Frost_Orb.blockymodel) on the Origin bone between his hands, hidden in the model (visible false) and shown only by the FrostUltimate* staff animations with shapeVisible, like the vanilla gun Laser attachment. Ice_Sword_Held attachment (2026-10-21): the ice sword for the sword slash, piece on the R-Hand bone (socket = his R-Attachment spot), hidden in the model and shown only by the IceSword* staff animations (they also tuck the staff away with R-Attachment z -36), same trick as Frost_Orb. Ice_Mace_Held attachment (2026-10-21): the vanilla Prisma mace repainted as pure ice, for the ground-slam attack; piece on the R-Hand bone like Ice_Sword_Held, hidden in the model and shown only by the IceMace* staff animations (they also tuck the staff away with R-Attachment z -36). Ice_Sword_Held_L attachment (2026-10-21): the same ice sword on his LEFT hand (piece on L-Hand, nodes IceSwordL_*), for phase 3 where the nunchucks fill his right hand; hidden, shown only by the nunchuck set's IceSword* animations. Ice_Sword_Held (right hand, IceSword_*) stays for the staff set's sword entries, unused now.
